projects.title: Does GenAI Help Those Who Need It Most?
projects.meta: AI for Humanity · University of Copenhagen · Course grade: 10
projects.description: A group research proposal on socioeconomic differences in the relationship between GenAI use and student performance. It proposes causal forests and discusses why voluntary adoption limits causal interpretation. No data collection or empirical results are claimed.

projects.title: Globalization and the Welfare State
projects.meta: Supervisor: Amalie Sofie Jensen · UCPH, June 2026
projects.description: Seminar paper with Jonas Skov Nielsen and Sheng Ye Michael Chen. Fixed-effects panel analysis of 32 OECD countries, 1980–2023: no robust relationship between globalization and social security transfers — but rolling regressions reveal a structural break in 2008 and a relationship that changes sign over time.
